nonparaphrase_operation: Replace an equivariant space by a base-plus-fiber description, mark every degeneration stratum, and separate intrinsic parameters such as interval length from gauge-like choices such as the coordinate origin.
source_support: The source presents the complex plane as a half-line carrying circles that shrink at its endpoint and the projective line as an interval carrying circles that shrink at both ends. nonparaphrase_operation: Convert faces into integral normal rays, identify a coordinate that is structurally constant across every ray, and only then quotient out that direction while retaining the varying lattice coordinates as the compressed dual data.
